entry.title: Weekly Market Update - 07 April 2025
entry.content:
Crypto Market

 

Crypto

BTC

ETH

Weekly High

$ 87,106

$ 1,921

Weekly Low

$ 76,710

$ 1,539


BTC and ETH Market Insight

 

China has implemented 34% reciprocal tariffs on goods from the United States. Powell stated that weak economic growth and rising inflation offset each other, prompting the Fed to maintain its expectation of two rate cuts in 2025. The S&P 500 ended the week down -9.1% in its largest weekly drop since March 2020, erasing -$4 TRILLION of market cap. US stocks have now erased a massive -$11 TRILLION since February 19th with recession odds ABOVE 60%. However, Bitcoin and altcoins have remained largely unaffected. In the last 24 hours, high-net-worth investors with over 10 BTC have increased their holdings.

 

 

Options Market

On the backdrop of the equity market plunging, BTC was holding rather well during the week until late Sunday where both BTC and ETH plummeted. Option flows saw overwhelming put buying. Calls are mostly sold to fund put buying. Front-end implied volatility spiked and the put skew rose to a more elevated level. One-week implied volatility for BTC moved to 66% and ETH to 93% as ETH once again got hit harder. This also pushed ETHBTC ratio to 0.02 mark - a new multi-year low. The market will closely monitor the development of the trade tension and stay volatile if any macro comes out.

 

Altcoins and Blockchain News

 

  • Circle may consider delaying its IPO plans due to the impact of the trade war. 

  • Grayscale has filed an S-1 form with the U.S. SEC for a Solana ETF. 

  • FDT denies allegations by Justin Sun, while Binance states that the FDUSD audit report confirms full 1:1 reserve support.

  • Hyperlane has disclosed details of its airdrop, with 57% of the token supply going to the community.

  • Babylon has revealed its tokenomics: a total supply of 10 billion tokens, with 15% allocated for community incentives.

  • ClearBank has partnered with Kraken to provide GBP clearing services for UK customers.

  • PayPal offers SOL and LINK payment options for U.S. customers.

  • Binance: Four users selling $1.05 million worth of spot ACT led to its price decline.

  • FTX rejected claims totaling over $2.5 billion due to non-compliance with KYC requirements

 

Macro

The major indices fell sharply after Trump’s tariffs policy was announced: the DJIA lost 7.9%, the S&P 500 -9.1%, and the Nasdaq -10.0%. The Chinese administration responded with an equal 34% reciprocal tariffs on U.S. goods. The Shanghai Composite Index lost 0.28%, the CSI 300 -1.37% and the Hang Seng index -2.46%.

entry.title: Weekly Market Update - 31 March 2025
entry.content:
Crypto Market

 

Crypto

BTC

ETH

Weekly High

$ 88,474

$ 2,097

Weekly Low

$ 81,488

$ 1,784


BTC and ETH Market Insight

 

The market is closely monitoring any potential tariff announcements from President Trump as we approach the April 2nd deadline. As a matter of fact, the market sentiment has started to turn sour on the PCE announcement.  Stronger-than-expected core PCE data also raised concerns about a potential delay in rate cuts, adding to market uncertainty. The risk-off price action continues to dominate in the market alongside higher treasury yield and gold price since then. Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw a drop of 73.6% in net inflows from the week prior, ending the week with a net outflow of $93.16 million on Friday.

 

 

Options Market

The realised volatility continued to drift lower during the beginning of the week until the sharp selloff kicked in on Friday. The one-week implied volatility rose more than 10 points for both BTC and ETH. ETH underwent a sharper selloff than BTC once again hence a higher increase on IV. ETHBTC ratio got pushed back down to 0.022 mark. Front-end skew shifted higher to favour puts as the demand for downside protection rose, It’s noteworthy that the mid-dated skew also moved a bit towards puts. This may indicate a potential sentiment shift for the market outlook in the mid term.

 

Altcoins and Blockchain News

 

  • Sonic Labs has canceled its plan to launch a USD-pegged algorithmic stablecoin and has instead chosen to develop an alternative stablecoin product denominated in UAE Dirhams.

  • The Binance Wallet team has launched a new feature called "Trade on DEX with CEX funds", allowing Binance users to use their Binance exchange (CEX) funds to trade millions of tokens on the Binance Wallet chain.

  • On March 28, according to Farside Investors, the US Ethereum spot ETFs recorded a net inflow of $4.7 million, ending a 17-day streak of no net inflows.

  • xAI, a company under Elon Musk, has acquired X through an all-stock transaction. The merged entity is unified under the name XAI HOLDINGS. The deal values xAI at $80 billion and X at $33 billion.

  • Hyperliquid announced that its blockchain has been upgraded, introducing a fully on-chain validator voting feature for asset delistings.

  • Virtuals Protocol announced an update to its fee distribution model: 70% of trading fees will go directly to the proxy creator’s wallet, while the remaining 30% will go to the Agent Commercial Protocol (ACP).

  • According to the Korea Herald, in 2024, Upbit operator Dunamu saw an 85% year-on-year increase in operating profit, reaching 1.19 trillion KRW ($811 million). Revenue surged 70.5% to 1.73 trillion KRW, and net profit increased 22% to 983.8 billion KRW.

  • On March 29, according to on-chain data, the Monad testnet has reached a total of 73,433,692 addresses.

 

Macro

The major benchmarks fell sharply for the week: the DJIA lost 2.3%, the S&P 500 lost 5.1%, and the Nasdaq lost 10.3%. Chinese equities continued the decline for the week: the Shanghai Composite Index shed 0.4%, the CSI 300 -0.01% and the Hang Seng index lost 1.11%.

entry.title: Weekly Market Update - 24 March 2025
entry.content:
Crypto Market

 

Crypto

BTC

ETH

Weekly High

$ 87,419

$ 2,090

Weekly Low

$ 81,259

$ 1,876


BTC and ETH Market Insight

 

The Fed decided to keep interest rates unchanged this week, but Trump is advocating for a reduction. While there wasn't a complete pause on QT, the Treasury runoff slowed from $25 billion to $5 billion, indicating that the Fed is concerned about downside risks. Bitcoin spot ETFs had six consecutive days of net inflows while Ethereum spot ETFs experienced a 13-day streak of net outflows. Liquidity conditions are tightening in both on-chain and futures markets.

 

 

Options Market

Although there weren't any clear signs of market rallying back to all-time highs, the persistent selling pressure seen from the past few weeks seemed to ease further. The realised volatility calmed down - BTC to sub 40 and ETH to sub 50. The implied volatility drifted lower in tandem. The negative volatility carry flipped to positive as gamma sellers returned. Put skew was flattening as prices stablised and the downside pressure eased. BTC continued to show a more confident view from the pricing. April 2 tariff deadline looms but the option pricing suggests another week of calmness..

 

Altcoins and Blockchain News

 

  • According to the official announcement, Binance has now completed the integration of USDC on the Aptos network and has opened deposit services.

  • The total number of addresses on the Monad testnet has surpassed 25 million, with approximately 14.41 million new addresses added in the past seven days. The total number of transactions has exceeded 400 million.

  • Pump.fun has announced the launch of PumpSwap, putting the project in direct competition with automated market makers specializing in on-chain token trading within the Solana ecosystem.

  • Crypto wallet infrastructure company Privy has raised $15 million in funding, led by Ribbit Capital, with participation from Hongshan, Paradigm, and Coinbase.

  • Hyperliquid has announced the introduction of staking tiers, where the tier level and trading fee reductions will be determined based on the amount of staked HYPE. This update is expected to go live on or after April 30.

  • Meteora has announced the launch of the Meteora Rising incubator, which will provide funding for tools that help liquidity providers (LPs) optimize, automate, or track their positions on DLMM.

  • EOS Network has announced that it will be rebranded as Vaulta, shifting its focus to Web3 banking services. This transition will be accompanied by a token swap expected to take place by the end of May.

  • Crypto prediction platform Yeet has raised $7.75 million in funding, led by Dragonfly, with angel investors including Pudgy Penguins CEO Luca Netz and LayerZero CEO Bryan Pellegrino.

 

Macro

The major indices recovered from the fall in the previous week: the DJIA added +1.6%, the S&P 500 +0.5%, and the Nasdaq +0.2%. Chinese equities continue the decline over the week: the Shanghai Composite Index lost 1.60%, the CSI 300 -2.29% and the Hang Seng index -1.13%.
